description: Choose how to find rentals, then narrow the search with rent, bed, bath, property-type, pet and sort filters. No login, cookies or proxy setup required.

bedrooms.description: Exact bedroom count filter, 0 for studio. Kept for existing tasks; use the range fields below for a range.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms (single count)

city.description: City name (San Francisco), slug (san-francisco-ca) or a Zumper city URL. Used by the city search modes and to narrow ZIP searches.
city.title: City

includeDetails.description: Makes one extra request per result to add full descriptions, square footage, price history, active-unit counts and building facts. Slower and more expensive.
includeDetails.title: Add detail-page data to search results

includeMarketStats.description: When a search finds no individual listings, return the city's average rent and rent-trend summary instead of an empty dataset.
includeMarketStats.title: Fall back to city market statistics

listingUrls.description: Zumper listing URLs, apartment-building URLs or numeric listing IDs. Used only by the details mode.
listingUrls.title: Listing or building URLs

maxBedrooms.description: Highest bedroom count to include; 5 means five or more.
maxBedrooms.title: Maximum bedrooms

maxItems.description: Upper limit on records returned. The actor stops early when Zumper has fewer matches.
maxItems.title: Maximum results

maxPrice.description: Highest monthly rent to include, in the listing's local currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum monthly rent

minBedrooms.description: Lowest bedroom count to include. Overrides the single bedroom count when set.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms

minPrice.description: Lowest monthly rent to include, in the listing's local currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum monthly rent

mode.description: Search a city by name or Zumper URL, search a ZIP code, or fetch details for specific Zumper listing/building URLs.
enumTitles: Search a city by name & state/province
Search using a city name, slug or Zumper URL
Search a US ZIP or Canadian postal code
Fetch details for specific listing or building URLs
mode.title: How should rentals be found?

pets.description: Only return rentals that accept the selected pets.
pets.title: Pet policy

propertyType.description: Narrow results to one property category.
propertyType.title: Property type

state.description: US state or Canadian province code. Used to disambiguate cities with the same name.
state.title: State or province

zipCode.description: US ZIP (94105) or Canadian postal code (M5V 2T6). Required for the ZIP search mode; also narrows a city search when provided.
zipCode.title: ZIP or postal code

title: Zumper Rental Listings Finder input
